title: Liability tailoring matrix and automated redline guidance for high-volume enterprise deals
creator: Asha Kapoor
description:
Goal: Reduce manual legal review and sales friction on high-volume enterprise deals by providing a liability-tailoring matrix and contextual automated redline recommendations for common MSA/DPA clauses (indemnity, liability caps, escrow options).

Scope:
- Create a decision matrix mapping customer tier, contract value, data-sensitivity classification, and industry to recommended liability/indemnity ranges and acceptable exceptions.
- Surface fielded guidance in the Sales contract UI and generate a suggested redline bundle for Legal review (human-in-the-loop).
- Gate suggested pricing adjustments when redline recommendations would materially increase exposure.
- Emit telemetry on exception frequency, time-to-approve, and pricing impact for later optimization.

Out of scope (first sprint):
- Fully automated approval for high-risk exception (still require Legal sign-off).
- On-prem specific indemnity permutations beyond standard template.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Decision matrix documented in Confluence with mapping rules and example scenarios.
2) Redline recommendation engine prototype integrated into contract UI that suggests clause text for indemnity and liability cap adjustments for at least 4 common scenarios.
3) Telemetry events emitted to the contracts analytics dashboard (exception-type, deal-id, suggestion-accepted boolean).
4) Legal/Revenue-ops approves the suggested recommendation flow and signoff path.
5) Pilot with two sales teams and two customers completed and feedback logged.

Success metrics:
- Reduce average Legal review cycle time for targeted deals by 30% within 60 days of pilot.
- Decrease sales stall rate from contract negotiation by 20% for pilot cohort.
- Reduce incremental pricing concessions attributable to indemnity / liability by 10% after recommendation tuning.
